confidence_meaning.HIGH: The observed primary outcome directly matches one protected definition; still unapproved.
confidence_meaning.LOW: The umbrella does not state a sufficiently dominant primary outcome; a strategic ruling is necessary.
confidence_meaning.MODERATE: A defensible primary reading with material cross-scope contribution or narrower historical corroboration.

intended_consumer: written strategic review on existing Mastermind architecture carrier

original_strategy_preservation.digest_algorithm: sha256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=False

proposals.objective_at_source: Connect the installed Mastermind Chrome extension to one authenticated Browser service so authorized ChatGPT, Claude, Grok Bot, OpenClaw and Fabric agents can discover enrolled estate browsers, select exact shared tabs, work concurrently on distinct tabs, and create tabs or windows with local consent. Completion requires installed one-host and two-host acceptance, recovery and revocation proof, and actual client use.
proposals.preserved_boundary: Browser permission and installed one-host/two-host acceptance remain separate; a strategic home grants neither.
proposals.rationale: Its direct outcome is coordinated, authenticated browser work by already authorized estate agents, including exact shared tabs, recovery and revocation. That enables governed operators to act across sessions through an existing service.

proposals.objective_at_source: Make the visitor-to-retention journey coherent, measurable, and trustworthy: genuine intelligence before registration; a personal act before a minimal free account; canonical state preserved through signup; measurable free and paid activation; contextual paid asks after value; authority-sourced billing; and a useful personalized return. Done means a real anonymous visitor can experience intelligence, save a personally meaningful state through free account creation, return to it, activate, upgrade at a measured value boundary, and retain — with every stage machine-readable from the existing analytics plane.
proposals.preserved_boundary: Preserve the existing analytics/event and billing owners.
proposals.rationale: The objective binds registration, preserved customer state, authority-sourced billing and measurable activation/retention into a trustworthy commercial path. Those account and commercial guarantees most directly fit the customer-platform outcome.

proposals.objective_at_source: Finish Commission 19 end to end under the Chairman's 2026-10-11 successor masterplan: the 18 C19 topics (C1-C18) are reconciled against their 19 report carriers, each in-scope producer (MAS-267 FIF cross-period, MAS-268 FIF query kernel, MAS-271 earnings expectations, MAS-272 capital structure, MAS-273 macro release/expectations, MAS-274 composer) is qualified against a specific consumer with a specific acceptance, the integrated answer path has real entitled-user and natural-source proof, and every remaining obligation is accepted, explicitly rejected/deferred, or held with an exact receiver. Done when MAS-263 can be closed truthfully by its acceptance evidence rather than by publication.
proposals.preserved_boundary: Producer-specific acceptance, entitled-user proof, natural-source evidence and declared scientific looks remain with their original owners.
proposals.rationale: The mission qualifies several independently owned producers, their time/identity and query seams, and an integrated answer path across financial, earnings, capital-structure and macro evidence. The reusable cross-domain composition is the proposed primary outcome.

proposals.objective_at_source: Take the accepted R15 Consumer economics design to a real source-bound, entitled, browser-visible PLNT economic-change experience. Done means an entitled user opens PLNT and sees a source-bound explanation of the selected reported revenue/advertising change with correct signs, scale and limitations, with anonymous users receiving no paid closure. V1-CORE (the deterministic composition) is the merged first wave; the entitled/browser legs stay frozen behind external owners.
proposals.preserved_boundary: The current blocked status and separately held entitled/browser legs remain unchanged.
proposals.rationale: The declared user outcome is a source-bound PLNT explanation of a reported revenue/advertising change, with correct signs, scale, limitations and entitlement. This is issuer-specific economic and event understanding.

proposals.objective_at_source: Implement the frozen Consumer Defensive CDV-1 vertical as bounded native producer, publication, reader and display lanes. Done means the adjudicated task chain is merged, qualified through the named gate job, and released with readers enabled before the disabled producer flag.
proposals.preserved_boundary: Readers-before-producer ordering, shared-foundation custody and source/mount acceptance gates are retained.
proposals.rationale: The Program boundary identifies the actual CDV-1 deliverable as the P&G demand and earnings-quality dossier. Its native producer, publication, reader and display lanes serve that company-research outcome.

Done when all three consumer positives, the declared market/population contract, independent numerical/temporal/access proof, installed production reads and correction/recovery/second-cycle evidence exist on main and live.

proposals.rationale: One declared equity-data view contract must serve Terminal OHLC, the canonical DataWorkspace read and basket membership/price composition, with numerical, temporal, access, correction and recovery proof. This is reusable owner-native intelligence across consumers.

proposals.objective_at_source: Extend the existing contradiction detector with the healthy-tension/impossible-contradiction classification and the existing response-eval system with deterministic numeric-to-source verification. Neither may create a replacement detector or rubric.

proposals.rationale: The exact work extends existing contradiction classification and deterministic numeric-to-source response verification. These are reusable reliability and evidence-evaluation capabilities rather than a single product interface or runtime lifecycle.

proposals.objective_at_source: Reach AUTONOMY_V1_PROVEN_LIVE by one complete real production acceptance operation on the installed Mastermind Executive host: Sol admits exactly one root through the canonical CEO ingress, the COO decomposes it, at least two governed workers execute child Jobs including a browser-proven UI child, one DECISION_REQUEST is ruled by Sol and consumed by the same operation, independent review and bounded repair run as separate Jobs, the runtime terminalizes without duplicate work under a recovery case, GitHub and Agent OS hold the evidence, and the host is disarmed and re-armed without credential re-exposure — with no second lifecycle, queue, router, retry ledger, identity plane or release controller created.

proposals.rationale: The required journey is one real CEO-originated root through COO decomposition, governed workers, decision consumption, independent review, repair and recovery. That directly establishes reliable executive orchestration without a second lifecycle.

proposals.objective_at_source: Complete Mastermind Executive OS, its Subagent Fabric bindings and the Mastermind OS app so that one real Chairman-originated request traverses the full multi-level path — authenticated identity, correct source custody, valid admission, economical placement, retained result, actual review, original-parent consumption, recoverable continuation and a coherent app outcome — and both a successful and an interrupted journey are proven on the live host. proposals.rationale: Its original Chairman request must traverse authenticated multi-level admission, economical placement, retained result, review, original-parent consumption and interrupted recovery with a coherent app outcome. The primary outcome is the governed company operating system.

proposals.rationale: The producer, downstream reader, causal transmission lab and product explain global liquidity transmission with point-in-time quality and a natural source-to-user update. The explicit primary deliverable is market-environment context.

proposals.objective_at_source: Let a user or machine inspect any sufficiently covered historical date before Mastermind existed, with source-bound market observations, first-print macro chronology, explicit unavailable evidence and separately revealed outcomes.
proposals.preserved_boundary: Historical coverage and retrospective compatibility are not prospective predictive evidence or permission to retune live settings.
proposals.rationale: The mission supplies source-bound historical observations, first-print macro chronology, explicit unavailable evidence and separately revealed outcomes to both people and machines. Its retained archive, filing and Data & Lab consumers make reusable historical evidence the proposed primary capability.

proposals.objective_at_source: Deliver the Marketing X docket (immutable 9651a77e, research/marketing_dockets/ catalyst_fable_20261031/) as a robust engine: a trustworthy SEC-event source-to-reader composition that gives first value without identification (A1/A2), a consent path that never grants, sends or discloses outside its gates (B1/B2), a rights-gated editorial asset factory with correction lineage (C1/C2), and a commercial bridge that passes only opaque attribution (D1), each proven to the rung its evidence reaches and never reported higher.

proposals.rationale: The assigned engine must deliver first anonymous value, gated consent, rights-safe editorial assets with correction lineage and an opaque-attribution commercial bridge. Trustworthy acquisition/consent/commercial behavior is the proposed primary company outcome.

proposals.objective_at_source: Turn the existing Analyst OS into a useful investment-research workspace that investigates evidence, computes financial implications, tests competing theses and carries an authorized case through the existing thesis and monitor owners. proposals.rationale: The existing Analyst OS must investigate evidence, compute financial implications, test rival theses and preserve a case through thesis/monitor owners. That is a coherent personal research-to-monitoring workspace with actual customer-path acceptance.

proposals.rationale: The bounded renderer replacement must preserve actual chart drawings, live bars, replay, pane sync, indicators and keyboard workflows under the existing chart contract. The observable outcome is the customer's live-analysis surface with equivalent behavior.

proposals.objective_at_source: Converge the existing news estate (qbus_news_* delivery, news_events/news_event_ledger, news_impact benchmark and producer, Mastermind get_intelligence/portfolio lens consumers, terminal news rail) into three independently accepted outcomes per research/news_intelligence_estate_20261021/MASTERPLAN.md: (1) reliable factual delivery with corrections and rights propagated and observable; (2) contextual research that cites events, sectors and themes against the existing MarketOntology and theme graph; (3) qualified quantitative influence only through the measured news_impact packets behind the registered section 11 gate. Done when the masterplan §9 seven vertical proofs (the first including a correction) are evidenced on production paths, each outcome has its own claim/evidence matrix, and no second store, scheduler, router, publication system or retry plane was built.
proposals.preserved_boundary: The three outcomes remain independently accepted; no global gate, new store or automatic quantitative authority is created.
proposals.rationale: The mission converges delivery, correction/rights propagation, contextual evidence and separately gated quantitative packets across existing news, ontology, portfolio and Terminal owners. Reusable evidence and correction-safe composition are proposed as the common primary capability.

proposals.objective_at_source: Enable an assigned Astra, Codex or Claude orchestrator to preserve one recorded project goal, phase plan, accepted work and next action across compaction and interruption, then continue a real multi-phase project through delegation, review and acceptance without repeated human instructions to continue.

proposals.rationale: The exact outcome preserves an original goal, phase plan, accepted work and next action across interruption, then continues through delegation, review and acceptance without repeated Chairman prompts. This is durable executive orchestration.

proposals.objective_at_source: Deliver the existing International product with the received foundation, ten views and existing-owner Saved integration, preserved legacy tools, truthful source qualification, independent review, served user journeys and a subsequent normal publication.
proposals.preserved_boundary: Source qualification, responsive/served journeys and existing Saved ownership remain required.
proposals.rationale: The retained International programme's actual views cover country inspection, macro/policy, risk/transmission, history/scenarios and qualified comparisons. Its core outcome is intelligible global and country context, even though much of the remaining work is presentation and saved investigations.

proposals.objective_at_source: Rebuild the autonomous, china and hk paper books into an engineered paper system whose numbers can be defended. The program is complete only when all three active books carry qualified current economics, every manager cycle is accountable, execution assumptions are realistic, lineage from snapshot to claim to target to outcome is reliable, the product is proven in an authenticated browser, experiments run in isolation, and incidents have a documented rollback path. The investment upgrade is a separate result. It is accepted only for its tested scope and only when its predeclared evidence criteria are met. Tilts that fail are removed or narrowed, and specialists that add nothing are removed. If no credible edge is proven, the product says so and limits its claim to supported research, disciplined simulation and decision accountability (masterplan section 12.2).
proposals.preserved_boundary: No account reset, repair trade, live-policy cutover or investment claim is authorized.
proposals.rationale: The required product makes the three paper books' actual economics, manager decisions, pending effects, performance and position reviews defensible in an authenticated interface. That portfolio operating experience is proposed as primary; the investment upgrade is expressly a separate result.

proposals.objective_at_source: Complete the Prophet upgrade end to end across US, China, Hong Kong and Canada under the Chairman's masterplan of 2026-10-20 (Prophet_End_to_End_Masterplan_Fable): every build unit B00–B28, question Q01–Q24 and decision D01–D12 dispositioned with evidence; the three core US sleeves (Early Leadership, Earnings, Cycle) accepted as useful, evidence-backed workflows; one shared research journey with truthful current-entry language on every surface (a quote is not a Buy; unavailable is not a maturity stage); US B4 entry built from current source over the frozen reader → B3 → B4 boundary; China, HK and Canada journeys proven market-native; served/installed/rollback proof before any release claim; an evidence-bound completion statement. proposals.preserved_boundary: A quote is not a Buy; unavailable is not maturity; source, served identity and rollback remain separate proof.
proposals.rationale: The masterplan requires useful Early Leadership, Earnings and Cycle sleeves, truthful current-entry language, qualified US entry and market-native China/HK/Canada research journeys. The direct outcome is evidenced opportunity discovery and timing.

proposals.objective_at_source: Turn company news into a measured, span-cited, typed business-impact packet that Prophet can consume as context_only evidence. proposals.preserved_boundary: The 600-case benchmark, section-11 gate and unchanged portfolios/B4/source-license boundaries remain.
proposals.rationale: The actual deliverable is a span-cited business-impact packet for three company-event templates, with numeric correctness and no unsupported supplier assertions. Its direct job is company/event interpretation consumed as context_only evidence.

proposals.objective_at_source: Deliver a rights-qualified public market-event story through the existing D14 Press pipeline, linked to its canonical stock dossier and the existing acquisition pathway, with verified publication and recoverable evidence.
